$description: Crystal design tokens, W3C DTCG format. Three tiers: primitive holds raw values, semantic names roles and aliases primitives, component binds semantics to control surfaces. Derived values (elevation-scaled shadows, rgba composites, scaled motion) are computed by the resolver, not stored here.

prism.$description: Electric violet, orchid light. The shared signature.

cobalt.$description: Clear blue with a violet undertone.

ion.$description: Vivid cyan and indigo for focused tools.

amethyst.$description: Rich purple with a warm luminous edge.

harbor.$description: The original palette, mapped to shared roles.

sm.$description: Viewport width at which the sm layout begins

md.$description: Viewport width at which the md layout begins

lg.$description: Viewport width at which the lg layout begins

radius.$description: Action controls are pill-shaped, independent of the content radius

gap.$description: Gap between an action's icon and its label

thumbMinLength.$description: Shortest a thumb may become, so a very long surface stays draggable

inset.$description: Gap between the thumb and the track edge

fadeDepth.$description: Depth of the scroll area edge fade, and the scroll padding that keeps focus clear of it

readingMax.$description: Widest a column of prose becomes, so a line stays a comfortable length

gutterCompact.$description: Shell gutter below the sm breakpoint

gutterBase.$description: Shell gutter between the sm and lg breakpoints

gutterWide.$description: Shell gutter at the lg breakpoint and above

minCellWidth.$description: Narrowest an auto-flowing grid cell becomes before the grid drops a column

sidebarWidth.$description: Default width of a shell's supporting panel: a two-word label plus an icon at comfortable density

size.$description: An icon in running content or beside a label

action.$description: The single icon inside an icon button

boxSize.$description: A checkbox box or a radio circle

boxRadius.$description: The checkbox box corner; a radio is a circle

thumbSize.$description: Slider thumb, padded to the target floor

height.$description: A compact chip, inside a 44px target

size.$description: The side of the rotated square that points at an overlay's trigger

radius.$description: The arrow's tip radius, so a pointer is not a needle

maxWidth.$description: How wide an anchored popover may grow before it stops being anchored to anything

tooltipMaxWidth.$description: About sixty characters: a tooltip longer than this is documentation

wellInset.$description: How much tighter a well's radius is than the shell containing it

radius.$description: Card-shaped buttons keep the content radius so artwork is not clipped

railWidth.$description: Selection is a leading rail plus label weight, never a check mark
